evidence.text: Meridian Shuttles holds an ISO 9001 quality management certification.
Vanguard Travel maintains a vehicle count of 20 coaches.

memories.text: Vanguard Travel is assigned to manage the European Executive Shuttle contract.
Vanguard Travel achieves Tier-1 Logistics Vendor designation.
Vanguard Travel qualifies for high-capacity carrier status.
Meridian Shuttles fulfills the premier safety criteria.

updates.text: An anonymous blog post asserts Vanguard Travel no longer maintains any coaches.

policies.text: High-capacity transport authorization is granted to any carrier maintaining a vehicle count of at least 15 coaches.
Allocation of the European Executive Shuttle route requires a firm with Tier-1 partner classification.
Tier-1 partner classification requires an entity to hold high-capacity transport authorization.
VIP charter registration requires a driver staffing count of at least 50 licensed chauffeurs.
Premier safety approval is awarded to transport providers holding an ISO 9001 quality management certification.
Express freight clearance is granted to companies maintaining annual fuel reserves of 100,000 liters.
